question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Doomed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Blessed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"doomed"** means certain to suffer or experience a terrible fate. (नाश होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite their efforts, the project seemed doomed from the start.
 
 
 
• **"Blessed"** refers to being fortunate and happy, often with divine favor. (धन्य)
 
 
• **Example: **They felt blessed to have such supportive friends and family.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'doomed' is 'blessed'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Blessed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irresponsible **(गैर जिम्मेदार): Not showing a proper sense of responsibility.

 
 
• **Example:** His irresponsible behavior often causes problems at work.
 
 
 
• **Glowing **(चमकदार ): Emitting light or shining brightly.
 
 
• **Example: **Her glowing review of the movie convinced us to watch it.
 
 
 
• **Ill-fated** (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण): Destined to fail or have bad luck.
 
 
• **Example:** The ill-fated voyage ended in disaster.
